# Coverage exemptions — one entry per line: `module` or `module:arm`
# (arm ∈ test-dir|matrix|dependabot|golangci; bare module = test-dir), '#' comments.
# An entry suppresses ONLY the named arm's demands for that module
# (module:dependabot suppresses BOTH its terraform and gomod demands, by design).
# Stale entries — dead module, or an exemption whose demanded entry exists — are RED.
# Every entry carries a date and a reason pointing at the work that retires it.
